# Blur Replace

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Motion

Use blurReplace when replacing one view with another should feel like a reveal. It combines blur and scale during insertion and removal; animate the state change, and disable the animation when Reduce Motion is enabled. Inspired by Enid (@ios_dev_alb).

- Before: Content only cross-fades
- After: Content blurs and scales

APIs: `transition(_:)`, `blurReplace`, `BlurReplaceTransition`, `animation(_:value:)`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

// iOS 17+. Present BlurReplaceDoExample() in your app.
struct BlurReplaceDoExample: View {
    @State private var phase = 0
    @State private var resetID = 0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            BlurReplaceDoContent(phase: phase)
                .frame(maxWidth: 320, minHeight: 180)
                .id(resetID)
            Button(phase.isMultiple(of: 2) ? "Reveal" : "Hide") { phase += 1 }
            Button("Reset") { phase = 0; resetID += 1 }
        }
        .padding()
    }
}

struct BlurReplaceDoContent: View {
    let phase: Int
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        // excerpt:start
        ZStack {
            if phase.isMultiple(of: 2) {
                VStack(spacing: 8) {
                    Image(systemName: "lock.fill").font(.title)
                    Text("Emperor").font(.caption)
                }
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                .background(.quaternary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 16))
                .transition(.blurReplace)
            } else {
                VStack(spacing: 8) {
                    Image(systemName: "crown.fill").font(.title)
                    Text("Emperor").font(.caption)
                }
                .foregroundStyle(.purple)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                .background(.purple.opacity(0.18), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 16))
                .transition(.blurReplace)
            }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth, value: phase)
        // excerpt:end
    }
}
```
